translationRepairs: He earned his jinshi degree in Daoguang 2 (1822), entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed a compiler in the Upper Study, and rose step by step to vice chamberlain.
He earned his jinshi degree in Daoguang 2 (1822), entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed a compiler, served in the Upper Study, and rose step by step to vice chamberlain.
授編修 and 直上書房 are successive postings; the compiler post is not itself in the Upper Study.

In Daoguang 29 (1849) when ministers debated converting southern grain tribute into a cash levy, Jianying and Governor Li Xingyuan argued forcefully that the scheme would be unworkable, and the plan was dropped.

In Daoguang 29 (1849) when ministers debated converting southern grain tribute into a cash levy, Jianying and Governor-General Li Xingyuan argued forcefully that the scheme would be unworkable, and the plan was dropped.
總督 is governor-general, not the provincial governor office rendered as Governor.
Liu Liangju of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices likewise urged revising southern Huai rules along northern Huai ticket-salt lines, aligning with Jianying's plan.
Liu Liangju, junior minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, likewise urged revising southern Huai rules along northern Huai ticket-salt lines, aligning with Jianying's plan.
鴻臚寺 is the Court of State Ceremonial, not the Court of Imperial Sacrifices (太常寺).

Liu Liangju, vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, also requested adapting the old southern Huai regulations and imitating northern Huai in implementing the ticket method, the same as Jianying's proposal.

Liu Liangju, junior minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, also requested adapting the old southern Huai regulations and imitating northern Huai in implementing the ticket method, the same as Jianying's proposal.
鴻臚寺 is the Court of State Ceremonial, not the Court of Imperial Sacrifices (太常寺).
He rose from clerk to director in the Ministry of Justice, served as intendant of the Huizhou-Chaozhou-Jiaxing circuit in Guangdong, and was eventually promoted to governor of Jiangsu.
He rose from clerk to director in the Ministry of Justice, served as intendant of the Huizhou-Chaozhou-Jiaying circuit in Guangdong, and was eventually promoted to governor of Jiangsu.
惠潮嘉道 is the Huizhou-Chaozhou-Jiaying circuit (嘉應), not Jiaxing (嘉興).
That autumn the Taiping leader Hong Xiuquan invaded Hunan, crossed Lake Dongting northward, and his forces were surging.
That autumn the Cantonese rebel leader Hong Xiuquan invaded Hunan, crossed Lake Dongting northward, and his forces were surging.
粵匪 names Hong as a Cantonese rebel leader; 'Taiping leader' imports a movement name not present in this Chinese sentence.

Following Guiqing's plan, former vice minister Zhang Fu was posted to southern Anhui to organize militia and oversee Huizhou-Ningguo defense, soon also covering Zhejiang's Qu and Yan prefectures to work with Guiqing against the rebels.
張芾 is Zhang Fu (芾 = fú), not Zhang Fen.

Nanjing had long been a rebel stronghold; the governor-general stayed at Changzhou while General He Chun directed military affairs and regional commander Zhang Guoliang assisted—former governor-general Yi Liang had handled only transport and supplies.
將軍和春 is a banner general, not a prince; 前督 is former governor-general.
